maintenance_items.label: Oil change
maintenance_items.description: Oil loses its lubricating properties with mileage and time. Regular changes protect the engine from premature wear.

maintenance_items.label: Oil filter
maintenance_items.description: The oil filter traps particles and contaminants. If saturated, oil circulates unfiltered and accelerates engine wear.

maintenance_items.label: Air filter
maintenance_items.description: A dirty air filter reduces power, increases consumption, and can damage intake sensors.

maintenance_items.label: Spark plugs
maintenance_items.description: Worn spark plugs increase consumption, make starting difficult, and can damage the ignition coil.

maintenance_items.label: Timing belt
maintenance_items.description: The timing belt is critical: if it breaks, the engine suffers severe damage. It must be changed at the manufacturer's interval without exception.
